entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. Order 774-0091B.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your order right here. Now, to make sure I'm following the right procedure, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. And I already tried to return it weeks ago, but your system didn't work.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what happened when you tried to process the return online?
The whole thing was a website error. I got halfway through the form, and then the whole return system was down. I couldn't print the label or anything. It was useless.
I understand the frustration. Do you happen to remember the date you tried?
Around the second of January. I even took a screenshot because I knew this would happen.
One moment, let me check our system logs for that date... Yes, I do see a record of a service outage on January 2nd that affected our returns portal. My apologies, that was definitely our fault.
Whatever.

Okay, let's get this sorted for you. I see the item was delivered 38 days ago. I'm just checking our official return policy... and yes, it states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
So?
So, you are well within the window. I can authorize this return for you immediately. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Do you see it?
Fine. It just came through. Finally.

Great. Just pack the VeloBand in its original packaging, attach that label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund processed back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
Okay. That's all.
Alright. Well, thank you for your patience, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No.
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
